text:
marco: Need a quick call on which billing model we pilot for Performance Lane: simple prepaid Burst SKUs vs. a small guaranteed baseline + best-effort bursts. We need a single direction for the pilot deck.

anya: Field: buyers keep asking for "no surprise bills". They'd accept burst packs if we show clear cost examples and a console estimate before purchase.

sophie: Finance: prepaid packs drive predictable cash and are easier to model. We prefer selling credits in packs and having a higher on-demand price. Avoid contract SLAs unless enterprise pays a premium.

drew: Eng ops: two tech tradeoffs: 1) full reservations require isolated infra and more ops; 2) softcap+priority scheduling with preemption is much cheaper and faster to ship. Recommend softcap + credits.

pricing-bot: Scan: recommend surge multiplier = 2.5x for on-demand top-ups, and offer discounted prepaid pack pricing (e.g., 10% off). Logged experiment ticket PR-5007.

legal-bot: Contract note: must include unambiguous "best-effort" language for bursts and a preemption clause. Example snippet: "Burst Credits increase scheduling priority but do not constitute a guaranteed performance SLA."

ops-lead: Operational gating: require telemetry hooks (softcap utilization, p95 delta) and an auto-disable rule if softcap causes >10% p95 regression in shared pools for 10m. Also need a simulated throttle mode for demos.

anya: GTM ask: buyer kit with three worked examples (chat, document-summarization, batch rerank), and a console mock that shows "estimated API-calls remaining" vs actual credits. Sales wants a one-click "apply burst" UX.

sophie: For the pilot let's pick prepaid packs + softcap behavior. Keep on-demand top-ups at 2.5x and make prepaid packs the recommended default. We'll monitor revenue vs. churn.

drew: I'll spec the softcap enforcement and sim-mode. Need an entitlement API and a small billing hook to decrement credits per concurrency-minute.

marco: Agreed. Action items: pricing-bot publish pack sizes & 2.5x surge proposal (Tue), legal-bot drop T&C snippet (Tue), drew implement entitlement flag + sim-mode prototype (next sprint), ops add alert rule (Wed), anya prep buyer kit and recruit pilot (Thu). Decision locked for pilot: prepaid Burst SKUs + softcap priority scheduling with best-effort bursts. Thanks all :thumbsup:
